name: Design Research
purpose: Analyze market references and translate them into reusable design evidence.
inputs: User goals, decision questions, context, constraints, and success metrics
Participant and source criteria with dated product, market, and accessibility references
Research method, sample plan, consent and privacy rules, and synthesis deadline
outputs: Dated evidence inventory with observations, quotations, and source provenance
Separated findings, hypotheses, patterns, and contradictions
Evidence-backed design recommendations with confidence and validation plan
stop_conditions: Every recommendation traces to evidence or a labeled assumption
No observation is presented as inference and source quality is recorded
Token budget exhausted or participant and privacy authority is unavailable
